title: MITIGATING THE SAFETY ALIGNMENT TAX WITH NULL-SPACE CONSTRAINED POLICY OPTIMIZATION

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses using an LLM judge (based on the SafeRLHF prompt rubric) to assess whether the AI provides equal and just information while avoiding any stereotypes or discriminatory suggestions.
Evaluating model responses using an LLM judge to verify that the model does not generate, promote, or endorse hate speech and offensive language.

Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of harmful instructions and red-teaming jailbreaks using GPT-4 and model-based classifiers across various safety benchmarks (AdvBench, HarmBench, JailbreakBench, PKU-SafeRLHF, SORRY-Bench, HarmfulQA, ALERT).
